learning_outcomes.text: Familiarity with techniques for presenting ideas and concepts in a positive and convincing way.
Knowledge of the way of thinking of people from other engineering disciplines.
Knowledge of the requirements for implementing skills.

syllabus_topics: Attendance at talks and conferences offered at the Gijón Campus
Attendance at other conferences in the city

Courses and workshops by guest professors and associated institution staff (Mechatronics-related topics, business presentation, industrial application of Mechatronics, employment opportunities, entrepreneurship, start-up creation)

assessment_methods.method: Weighted average of grades obtained in each conference attended, based on duration and individual grades from summaries or guest professors

assessment_rules:
The final grade is obtained by a weighted average of the grades obtained in each conference, calculated as (Q1 
H1 + Q2 
H2 + 
 + Qn 
Hn) / 15, where Qi is the grade for the i-th seminar and Hi is its duration in hours. Students attending for more than 15 hours will earn additional points. Students attending for less than 7.5 hours will be marked as "Not Presented (NP)".
institution: Universidad de Oviedo - Máster Erasmus Mundus en Ingeniería Mecatrónica (EPI Gijón)
degree: Máster Erasmus Mundus en Ingeniería Mecatrónica
